entries.title: Acts 15:1
segments: But certain persons came down from Judea, and began to teach the Brethren that, unless they were circumcised, in accordance with the custom enjoined by Moses, they could not be saved.

entries.title: Acts 15:2
segments: This gave rise to a serious dispute, and much discussion, between Paul and Barnabas and these men, and it was therefore settled that Paul and Barnabas and others of their number should go up to Jerusalem, to consult the Apostles and Officers of the Church about the matter under discussion.

entries.title: Acts 15:3
segments: The Church, therefore, sent them on their journey, and they made their way through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling the story of the conversion of the Gentiles, to the great joy of all the Brethren.

entries.title: Acts 15:4
segments: On their arrival at Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the Church, as well as by the Apostles and the Officers, and gave an account of all that God had helped them to do.

entries.title: Acts 15:5
segments: Some of the Pharisees' party, however, who had become believers in Christ, came forward and declared that they were bound to circumcise converts and to direct them to observe the Law of Moses.

entries.title: Acts 15:6
segments: The Apostles and the Officers of the Church held a meeting to consider this question.

entries.title: Acts 15:7
segments: After much discussion, Peter rose and said: "You, my Brothers, know well that long ago God singled me out--that through my lips the Gentiles should hear the Message of the Good News, and become believers in Christ.

entries.title: Acts 15:8
segments: Now God, who reads all hearts, declared his acceptance of the Gentiles, by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us.

entries.title: Acts 15:9
segments: He made no distinction between them and us, when he purified their hearts by their faith.

entries.title: Acts 15:10
segments: Why, then, do you now provoke God, by putting on the necks of these disciples a yoke which neither our ancestors nor we were able to bear?

entries.title: Acts 15:11
segments: No, it is through the loving-kindness of the Lord Jesus that we, just as they do, believe that we have been saved."

entries.title: Acts 15:12
segments: Every voice in the assembly was hushed, as they listened to Barnabas and Paul, while they gave an account of all the signs and wonders which God had shown among the Gentiles through them.

entries.title: Acts 15:13
segments: After they had finished speaking, James addressed the Council. "Brothers," he began, "hear what I have to say.

entries.title: Acts 15:14
segments: Simon has described the manner in which God first visited the Gentiles, in order to take from among them a people to bear his Name.

entries.title: Acts 15:15
segments: And that is in harmony with the words of the Prophets, where they say--

entries.title: Acts 15:16
segments: '"After this I will return; and I will rebuild the House of David which has fallen--its very ruins I will rebuild, and will set it up once more;

entries.title: Acts 15:17
segments: That so the rest of mankind may earnestly seek the Lord--even all the Gentiles on whom my Name has been bestowed."

entries.title: Acts 15:18
segments: Says the Lord, as he does these things, foreknown from of old.'

entries.title: Acts 15:19
segments: In my judgement, therefore, we should not add to the difficulties of those Gentiles who are turning to God,

entries.title: Acts 15:20
segments: But we should write to them to abstain from food that has been polluted by being sacrificed to idols, from impurity, from eating the flesh of strangled animals, and from blood.

entries.title: Acts 15:21
segments: For in every town, for generations past, there have been those who preach Moses, read as he is in the Synagogues every Sabbath."

entries.title: Acts 15:22
segments: It was then decided by the Apostles and the Officers, with the assent of the whole Church, to choose some of their number, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. Those chosen were Judas (called Barsabas) and Silas, who were leading men among the Brethren.

entries.title: Acts 15:23
segments: They were bearers of the following letter--'The Apostles, and the Brothers who are the Officers of the Church, send their greetings to the Brethren of Gentile birth in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.

entries.title: Acts 15:24
segments: As we had heard that some of our number had upset you by their assertions, and unsettled your minds--without instructions from us--

entries.title: Acts 15:25
segments: We met and decided to choose certain men and send them to you with our dear brothers Barnabas and Paul,

entries.title: Acts 15:26
segments: Who have sacrificed themselves for the Name of our Lord, Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Acts 15:27
segments: We are accordingly sending Judas and Silas, and they will tell you by word of mouth what we are now writing.

entries.title: Acts 15:28
segments: We have, therefore, decided, under the guidance of the Holy Spirit, to lay no further burden upon you beyond these necessary conditions--

entries.title: Acts 15:29
segments: That you abstain from food offered to idols, from blood, from eating the flesh of strangled animals, and from impurity. If you guard yourselves against such things, it will be well with you. Farewell.'

entries.title: Acts 15:30
segments: So the bearers of this letter were sent on their way, and went down to Antioch. There they called a meeting of all the brethren,

entries.title: Acts 15:31
segments: And delivered the letter, the reading of which caused great rejoicing by its encouraging contents.

entries.title: Acts 15:32
segments: Judas and Silas, who were themselves Prophets, further encouraged the Brethren by many an address, and strengthened their faith.

entries.title: Acts 15:33
segments: After some stay, they were dismissed with kind farewells from the Brethren, and returned to those who had sent them.

entries.title: Acts 15:34
segments: (Translation omits this verse)

entries.title: Acts 15:35
segments: Paul and Barnabas, however, remained in Antioch, where they taught and, with the help of many others, told the Good News of the Lord's Message.

entries.title: Acts 15:36
segments: Some time after this, Paul said to Barnabas: "Let us go back and visit the Brethren in every town in which we have told the Lord's Message, and see how they are prospering."

entries.title: Acts 15:37
segments: Barnabas wished to take with them John, whose other name was Mark;

entries.title: Acts 15:38
segments: But Paul felt that they ought not to take with them the man who had deserted them in Pamphylia, and had not gone on with them to their work.

entries.title: Acts 15:39
segments: This caused such unpleasant feeling between them that they parted, Barnabas taking Mark and sailing for Cyprus,

entries.title: Acts 15:40
segments: While Paul chose Silas for his companion and, after he had been committed by the Brethren to the gracious care of the Lord,

entries.title: Acts 15:41
segments: Started on his journey and went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the Churches in the faith.
